messages:
Alex P: FYI our replay harness this morning shows a weird tail spike not present in the synthetic load runs. p50/p95/p99 (synth) = 28/68/120ms vs (replay) = 30/90/420ms. Anyone change kernel selector or batching heuristics overnight?
Maya (ML): I noticed the selector started preferring matmul-v2 for short sequences after the recent heuristics tweak (PR #4521). Could be a poor microkernel for KV cache hot paths.
Alex P: Ah ok. The change log mentioned a confidence threshold bump. Does that affect runtime fallback?
Maya (ML): It skips the old fallback if confidence >= 0.7. If KV warmup is incomplete, matmul-v2 has worse throughput under many small KV hits -> tail.
Simon R: Can you attach a short profile? Even a flame or perf top dump helps. Also want to verify batching windows — synthetic uses 8ms aggregation, replay preserves original timings which can scatter requests.
Alex P: attaching snippet from quick perf: 
```
[perf sample]
cpu: 65% user, 20% sys
matmul-v2: 42%
kv-cache-lock: 18%
speculative-decoder: 8%
```
Simon R: That kv-cache-lock number is suspicious. Might be contention in the cache shim when kernel path switches. Can you run replay with --kv-warmup=on and --kernel-force=baseline for apples-to-apples? Command: `./bench/replay --trace=short --preserve-timestamps --kv-warmup=on --kernel-force=matmul-baseline`
Priya: Heads-up: the regression gate did fire on the staging runs last night but the gate's action was set to warn not block due to a transient TTL override (PR #4504). I reverted the TTL but we still need root cause.
Alex P: Confirming — the gate TTL was 30m and was bumped to 120m by ops script, so it didn't auto-block during the deploy. Will log that.
Liam: I'll run an apples-to-apples matrix: (synthetic/replay) x (matmul-v2/baseline) x (kv-warmup on/off) and collect p50/p95/p99 + kv contention counters. Scheduling now, ETA 45m.
Maya (ML): Good. Also add a run with speculative-decoding disabled (`--speculative=off`) — spec decoding was contributing CPU spikes in a different run last week.
infra-bot: deploy/redwood-runtime v8.3.1 rolled to staging at 2026-03-18T09:12:07Z (commit abc123). Regression gate status: WARN -> manual review required.
Simon R: After Liam's runs, let's compare traces and kernel-selection logs (enable `--dump-kernel-decisions`). If matmul-v2 is consistently chosen only under certain inter-arrival distributions, we should tweak the confidence threshold or add a KV-hit bias.
Alex P: Plan: Liam runs matrix; attach traces to this thread; if matmul-v2 is the culprit, we'll rollback the selector bump and open a targeted perf PR with a KV-bias patch and regression gate set to block.
Maya (ML): Also worth running a short microbenchmark that isolates KV cache hotpath to reproduce without full replay. I can sketch one and post it.
Liam: starting run now, will post results + perf profiles here when done :rocket:
Alex P: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
